certificate.guarantee: Conditional on these fixed coupled motor tapes, equally weighted opposite-heading starts, the documented held-input/no-prehit-feedback rule, and no heading-informed initial controller/private-random state. Covers arbitrary common stochastic action sequences with clocks and previous-action memory, not only constant actions. Mathematical bound uses native equations with the stated numerical tolerance; it is not a universal Gaussian-noise ceiling.
certificate.stopping: Stop success at first actual hit, before respawn. If both cases succeed, the surviving case supplies a single continued reflected path through both disks; post-hit reset/reward in the stopped case is irrelevant.
certificate.proof: With common body motors/actions/noise and a pi heading offset, free displacements are opposite until a hit. Before any wall the goal targets in one common displacement frame are disks centered at plus/minus(G-P). From zero, visiting one disk costs at least D-R; passing to the other costs at least2(D-R). Therefore both successes require path length at least3(D-R). The all-action motor-norm recurrence bounds any policy path.
certificate.unconditional_noise_scope: Gaussian noise is unbounded. For a newly drawn tape, a uniform statement can use success<=0.5+0.5*Pr(the path/wall certificate event fails), with that failure probability separately bounded; this script does not estimate it.
certificate.physical_tape_rule: Use the exact30body-noise/action draws at this context FREE onset, not tape indices0:30.
certificate.observation_rule: Frozen collector: blackRGB, held ordinary endpoint snapshot and saved goal; actual previous action; zero previous reward before first-hit termination. No unrecorded heading input or heading-informed private controller state.
certificate.source_scope: Read-only saved-input adapter. No policy/environment execution, no new bound, no outcome-dependent exclusion.
